text_block_list.text: Whoosh, rumble!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oho! A golden opportunity! Is this a
dream?! Am I
dreaming?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Trainer! This our chance to race Suzuka
again
before the Takarazuka Kinen!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Today is the Fan Fest—a time when
Tracen
Academy welcomes fans onto
campus with a
variety of events.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The highlight is the sports competition,
where the
students participate in events
they don't normally
do, like ball games
and martial arts.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's still got the edge on me in running,
but
maybe I can take her in a different
event...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Сайленс Судзука claims a sweeping
victory
in racewalking too! She just
marched on silent and
steady!
text_block_list.name: Event Commentator

text_block_list.text:
I was completely focused on walking...
Did I do
well?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука dominates the volleyball
match
with a superhuman—no,
super-Umamusume jump!
text_block_list.name: Event Commentator

text_block_list.text:
All I did was run and jump. My teammate
fed me
the ball perfectly...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
No way! She's even untouchable outside
of racing!
She's a natural athlete!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I've got it! I can take her in a
three-legged race!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука dominates the
three-legged race
as well! Silence
Suzuka and Спешл Уик—a
match
made in heaven!
text_block_list.name: Event Commentator

text_block_list.text: We did it, Suzuka!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Qué?! Et tu, Spe?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter! Some way, somehow, I
gotta
beat Suzuka and get myself back
on track!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I don't care what it takes, Trainer! I'll do
anything!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Let's settle this fair and square, Suzuka!
In the
ring! Let's wrestle!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Whaaat? But that's your specialty, El!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Is there even a wrestling event? I think
there's
sumo wrestling, but...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Sumo is fine!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
All right, let's go, Suzuka! Let's get our
sumo on!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Um, w-wait a minute...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса drags Сайленс Судзука to
the ring,
and the sumo match begins.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hu—what?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
It doesn't take long before El Condor
Pasa is
knocked out of the ring.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
W-wow... I was railroaded! She blasted
forward
like a runaway train with
immense strength!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: This is Сайленс Судзука! The OP train!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: You can do it, Эль Кондор Паса!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text: You're the only one who has a chance!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
Ohhh! This cheering... this hope! Can I
really let
their calls go unanswered?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
No! Of course not! Suzuka, one more
round! Let's
do this!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Zoom!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Aggghhh!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: But it's not over yet!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Ooohhh!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса stands back up
heroically each
time her fans cheer her
on.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And each time she stands up, her own
spirits rise
as well.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: You're still standing?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Everyone's cheerin' for me to win! This is
the last—
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Gyaaah!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Zoom!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Aaaughhh!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
In the end, Эль Кондор Паса doesn't win
even a
single bout.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now for our interview with this year's
MVP,
Сайленс Судзука. Any comments?
text_block_list.name: Interviewer

text_block_list.text: I'm completely exhausted...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Next up, this year's recipient of the
Tenacity
Prize, Эль Кондор Паса!
text_block_list.name: Interviewer

text_block_list.text: I-I... I'm so devastated!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Heeey, Suzuka! Team El is gonna grind
your army
into dust one day! You hear
me?! DUST!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Overwhelmed with frustration, El Condor
Pasa
ends up sounding like a heel
wrestler.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your support, everyone!
You won't
regret it!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Just you wait! One day, I will have... my

reveeenge!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Heartwarming applause and laughter
breaks out
in the audience.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Although she lost, Эль Кондор Паса's
incredible
determination has won the
hearts of fans.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Uhh... judges? Could you make El the
MVP?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Personally, I think she's the biggest
reason the
Fan Fest was so exciting.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Thud!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Gasp!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: My toe is... outside the ring...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Did I... do it?! I did it! I finally won!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса wrings out every last
drop of her
strength to pull off a win,
and the audience goes
wild!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now for our interview with this year's
MVP,
Сайленс Судзука. Any comments?
text_block_list.name: Interviewer

text_block_list.text: I'm not the real MVP.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
You should be interviewing El. She's the
one that
got the crowd going.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Well then, Эль Кондор Паса. Any
comments?
text_block_list.name: Interviewer

text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, thank you, everyone! Thank you
so much!
I'm so grateful!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
It's thanks to your support that I could
beat
Suzuka!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса is enveloped in the wild
cheering.
Without a doubt, her fans will
be watching her
next race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
See you at the Takarazuka Kinen,
Suzuka!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I've been looking forward to a rematch
ever since
the Mainichi Okan.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
You're the greatest obstacle before me
on my
journey to success—the dragon at
the gates! But
I'm stronger than ever, so
get ready for a fight!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: All right, but you won't win this time.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
What has been won, and what has yet to
be
achieved. It seems Эль Кондор Паса has
made her
determination clear to Silence
Suzuka.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Quite a generous comment, considering
how
much the Fan Fest served to
reaffirm Silence
Suzuka's fearsome
strength.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
